subject: english
question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. The deeper you immerse it, the greater will be the difference in the water level.

B. This difference in the levels in the U-tube is a measure of the pressure applied by your palm.

C. If you immerse the funnel into a bucket of water, you will again see the difference in the water level in the U-tube.

D. When you gently apply pressure on the rubber film with your palm, you will find that a difference in the water level is created in the manometer.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'DBCA'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• ** **While arranging the parts of the passage, **we should find some grammatical or contextual connections between them-**__

 
 
• **​D is the first sentence** as it describes the difference in the water level is created in the manometer.
 
• **B is the second sentence** as it describes the measures of the pressure of the water levels in the U - tube.
 
• **C is the third sentence** as it describes you will again see the difference in the water level if you immerse the funnel into a bucket of water.
 
• **A is the last sentence** as it concludes the deeper you immerse it, the greater will be the difference.
 
 

**Thus, the correct order is DBCA:**

 
• **d**. When you gently apply pressure on the rubber film with your palm, you will find that a difference in the water level is created in the manometer.
 
• **b. **This difference in the levels in the U-tube is a measure of the pressure applied by your palm.
 
• **c.** If you immerse the funnel into a bucket of water, you will again see the difference in the water level in the U-tube.
 
• **a.** The deeper you immerse it, the greater will be the difference in the water level.
